Spider-Man: Brand New Day Film Achieves Strong Box Office Performance in India

The film 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' has achieved significant box office success in India, grossing ₹100 crore within its first two days and ₹131.46 crore overall. Opening day collections reached ₹73 crore, reportedly surpassing 'Avengers: Endgame' as the biggest Hollywood opening in India. The film's director, Destin Daniel Cretton, discussed balancing spectacle with emotion and the hero's journey. Coverage also includes explanations of the film's ending, including potential hints about Peter Parker and Ned's memories and future MCU destinations.
